faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Assistant position at IIT BHU is 10 September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's and Master's Degree in Sciences (Biotechnology, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Genetic Engineering) or a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Technology (Biotechnology) from a recognized university or its equivalent.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant position is 28 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/Women/PwD and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 27,000/- plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT BHU Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach required documents, and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview, which may be conducted either online or in person.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT BHU offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. It is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST/Women/PwD candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates, in addition to relaxations for those with relevant research experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Assistant at IIT BHU is a contractual role.
